---
title: "Data stories, simply told"
listing:
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  categories: false
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
---

Hey there, welcome to my Weblog! I break down complex data into stories that actually make sense for everyone.

<script>
function fixListing(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.quarto-post').forEach(function(post){
    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(post, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
    var n;
    while(n = walker.nextNode()){
      if(n.nodeValue.includes('Australia Climate Bushfires') && !n.parentElement.closest('.listing-tags')){
        n.nodeValue = '';
      }
    }
    post.querySelectorAll('.listing-tags').forEach(function(t){ t.remove(); });
    if(post.innerText.includes('Was Black Summer')){
      var title = post.querySelector('h3, .listing-title, a.title');
      var body = title ? title.closest('div') : post;
      var desc = post.querySelector('.listing-description');
      var box = document.createElement('div');
      box.className = 'listing-tags';
      box.innerHTML = '<a>AUSTRALIA</a><a>CLIMATE</a><a>BUSHFIRES</a>';
      if(desc){
        desc.after(box);
      } else if(body){
        body.appendChild(box);
      } else {
        post.appendChild(box);
      }
    }
  });
}
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fixListing);
setTimeout(fixListing, 300);
setTimeout(fixListing, 1000);
</script>
